description: This Java source file defines a cluster singleton actor called PolicyEventForwarder in the Akka framework. Its main purpose is to subscribe to policy events, process and filter these events based on namespace blocking, maintain a revision map of policies, and periodically dump this revision information. It forwards relevant policy tags and references to other actor components such as the thingsUpdater and persistence layer, and manages a stream using Akka Streams to perform periodic dump operations.

classes.name: PolicyEventForwarder
classes.description: A cluster singleton actor managing subscription to policy events, filtering, revision tracking, and periodic dumping of policy revision data, while forwarding relevant events to other actors.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for instantiating a PolicyEventForwarder actor with required dependencies.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates streams when actor stops.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling logic for different message types, including PolicyEvent, PolicyTag, PolicyReferenceTag, control commands, and stream management.

methods.name: policyEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming policy events, applies namespace blocking filters, and converts to policy tags for further processing.

methods.name: updatePolicyRevision
methods.description: Updates the internal map tracking maximum revisions for each policy ID.

methods.name: forwardToThingsUpdater
methods.description: Forwards policy reference tags to the thingsUpdater actor.

methods.name: dumpPolicyRevisions
methods.description: Handles requests to dump current policy revisions to the sender.

methods.name: streamTerminated
methods.description: Handles stream termination events, logs errors or info, and restarts the stream.

methods.name: subscribeAck
methods.description: Logs acknowledgment of subscription to the pub-sub mediator.

methods.name: restartPolicyReferenceTagStream
methods.description: Sets up or resets the periodic stream that triggers dump operations.

methods.name: terminateStream
methods.description: Shuts down the current stream if active.

methods.name: mapDumpResult
methods.description: Converts the dump result into a Source<PolicyReferenceTag, NotUsed> for processing or logs errors.
